text:
Carter Verhaeghe has 10 goals in 19 games and has carried more than his share with Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand on injured reserve. Eight of his 17 points are on the power play, and his goals have come at useful moments.

Here's the catch. He's shooting 24%, against 13% last season, and Florida has scored eight more goals than expected with him on the ice. The chances are good (7.2 expected goals is a strong total), but that finishing rate rarely lasts, so expect the goal pace to slow even if the play doesn't.

The play is the reason he's a three-time Cup winner. Evolving-Hockey had him driving play last season while facing top competition, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking likes his breakouts (72% of exits with the puck) and his setups (93rd percentile in primary shot assists). Our range has him at 25 to 40 goals, which tells you how good the floor is.
